label: preparing
what: Probably an undisclosed gathering or social occasion in the town hall at eighteen, possibly a surprise, rather than a confirmed bridge or port alteration. I was invited by neighbour to an 'ordinary meeting' and told nothing needed preparing, yet on arriving early I found innkeeper, freight and builder waiting together in the lantern-equipped great hall. Earlier reports placed those three with baker and neighbour at the bakery, including bread being carried. This suggests coordinated preparation, but I have not heard an admission or seen evidence establishing its exact purpose. Baker's participation is less certain than that of the people waiting in the hall; ordinary food trading is also a possible explanation for the bakery reports. I cannot identify any additional knowingly helping person: secretary has openly maintained my schedule and investigated the rumours, without evidence of knowing a hidden plan.
